verdict.rationale: Fireflies' own marketing explicitly promises "detailed notes, action items, and customized summaries instantly after every meeting" and AskFred lets users query meeting content, matching the structured-summary story, but this is vendor-stated rather than independently verified for decision/next-step accuracy or share-without-editing quality. missing for 10: independent/hands-on review confirming summary structure (key points, decisions, next steps) and confirming it needs no editing before sharing.
